newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sipef sees H2 1996 current same as H1.
newsitem.headline: Sipef sees H2 1996 current same as H1.

text.p: Belgian agricultural holding company Sipef NV said on Friday first-half current profit would be at least maintained, and perhaps improved, in the second six months of 1996.

Sipef more than doubled first-half 1996 group net profit to 160 million francs. Current profit rose 42 percent to 320 million francs, thanks to favourable exchange rates and a reduction in financial charges, the company said in a statement.
Turnover declined slightly, to 1.71 billion francs from 1.85 billion francs, due to a temporary decline in the price of raw materials.
Palm oil accounted for 48 percent of turnover, and 48 percent of turnover was in Indonesia, it said.
